channel.title: Wire — Kubernetes
channel.description: Kubernetes from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: DRA Updates
item.description: Kubernetes 1.37 is here and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) keeps pushing past where it started! This release brings DRA Extended Resource support to GA, a milestone the team has been building toward for three straight releases. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Scale Workloads to Zero with HorizontalPodAutoscaler
item.description: Kubernetes v1.37 includes API support for horizontal autoscaling of workloads down to zero replicas. This feature is now Beta and enabled by default. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Kubernetes Promotes KYAML as a Safer, More Consistent Way to Work with Manifests
item.description: Kubernetes is encouraging developers to take a closer look at KYAML, a stricter dialect of YAML designed to make Kubernetes configuration more explicit, predictable, and less prone to common YAML errors. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)
